name: Financial Assistance for ANM/GNM/Technical Courses
benefit: - Financial Assistance to the youths of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community for training of Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM)/General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM)/Para-Medical and other job assured technical and professional Diploma and Degree courses. - The training must have a minimum duration of one year and can be conducted in both Government and Non-Government Institutes.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam. - The applicant must belong to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. - The applicant's family income must not exceed ₹5,00,000/- per annum. - The applicant must currently be undergoing the course in a Government or Government Recognized Institute. - The applicant must be undergoing professional, job-oriented technical Diploma/Degree courses. - The applicant must be enrolled in a course with a minimum duration of one year.
